# P31.19 (CLOSE.1): Round-9 closeout — scoped leak check (ADR-119) + armed CI, closure verification, OPEN-row sweep, whole-build capstone, projectStatus

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.19__round9-closeout.md` (manifest row 160, semantic id `CLOSE.1`), the
Round-9 tail. Stacked on `devin/p31-16-rematerialize-reexport-republish` (PR #153). Requirement ids:
SIG-ENG-003 (ADR-119), SIG-ENG-039 (Appendix F row), the D3 env-only-secrets rule the scoped check
guards. No merge, tag or `main` push.

## Summary

- **D-P30.4-4 → DONE (operator Q7 = (a), ADR-119 = ADR-R9-LEAKSCOPE).**
  `test_gcp_project_id_is_env_resolved_not_committed` no longer greps *every* tracked file: it greps an
  explicit code + config include list (`_PROJECT_ID_SCOPE` — every §47 package `src/`, the `db` sqitch
  surfaces, `ontology/vocab` + `ontology/generated`, `ops/`, `web/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`,
  root + package build/deploy config) with a zero-resolution guard. `docs/` — the append-only build
  memory under `docs/build/`, `docs/tickets/`, `docs/adr/` — is deliberately exempt: the id is *recorded*
  there as history (cannot be rewritten, P1–P3) and a GCP project id is not a credential. Option (b)
  redaction was **not** chosen and is not done — 71 `docs/` occurrences remain, verified.
- **Armed in CI** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): the security job runs the test with
  `SIG_GCP_PROJECT: ${{ vars.SIG_GCP_PROJECT }}` — a repo **variable**, not a secret; the step skips when
  unset, so it can never be a false red.
- **Armed verification:** `SIG_GCP_PROJECT=zeta-medley-508121-u7 uv run pytest
  tests/connectors/test_secrets.py` → **4 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed** (zero in-scope occurrences).
- **Every Round-9 closure verified.** All scheduled→P31.x deferral rows audited: the closures carry dated
  live evidence (P31.1–P31.16 records), and the five public-surface closures were re-probed live
  (read-only): `/` 200 + "provisional eval" disclosure, `/map/points.json` 404 (R8-1 stays closed),
  `/data-freshness/` 200, `/network/` 200, tile range GET 206.
- **Sweep:** `DEFERRALS.md` gains the "P31.19 sweep" table — **24 OPEN/PARTIAL rows**, each with owner,
  precise blocker and landing. D-R6.1-EVAL / D-P30.2b-1 / D-P30.2b-2 stay **OPEN**, owned by Round 10
  (human review campaign → P31.18); the PROVISIONAL disclosure is unchanged; no artifact claims eval
  closure.
- **Capstone green** (`docs/build/reports/CAPSTONE_VERIFICATION_2026-09-27.md`): `make check` **4,403
  passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed** + verify-gen clean; `make test-db` **280/0**;
  `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 pytest tests/e2e` **16/0 xfailed**; coverage matrix **677 rows OK**; ADR/spec/
  backlog checkers green. No assertion loosened; no `LD-` xfail touched.
- **D-P31.4-1 recorded honestly:** the 2026-10-10 `sig-sched-camreg-batch-05` replay has not happened
  (this ticket ran 2026-09-27) — the row stays **OPEN** with its exact verify command. No pre-dated green.
- **`projectStatus` stays `IN-PROGRESS`** (BM-TAIL-03): ACCEPT-R8 is unsigned (condition 1), and a
  **not-yet-seeded Round-10 landing does not satisfy the rule** (condition 4). Stated plainly in the
